prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Click the tray icon to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Got It"}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet mascot greeting screen: Adds an engaging mascot greeting screen prior to path selection to introduce the desktop pet concept.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_mascot_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_mascot_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Virtual Buddy", "body": "Choose a companion path to customize a desktop pet tailored to your daily routine.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Continue"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption certificate badge highlight sub-flow: Replaces the default certificate stamp with an official pet verification badge element on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion profile is registered and ready for desktop deployment.", "replace": {"official_stamp": [{"type": "badge", "role": "official_stamp", "text": "Verified Desktop Pet", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Full-bleed story screen layout redesign: Redesigns the onboarding story intro screen using a full-bleed visual layout for an immersive first impression.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "body": "Bring your computer to life with a pet that responds to your workspace activities."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account sign-in security reassurance hint: Adds an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in locks in pet retention.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your companion profile and prevents pet progress reset."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen live progress timer: Enables countdown timer estimates and step progress counter on the waiting screen while rendering the pet model.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "hint": "Generating 3D assets and desktop rendering models..."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion archetype choice headline copy: Updates path selection screen headline to focus on selecting a daily companion archetype.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Companion Archetype", "body": "Pick the companion dynamic that best matches your work style."}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop taskbar pet location hint: Adds a helpful hint on the final setup screen detailing where the pet icon is located on the taskbar.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Your pet operates in the background. Click the taskbar icon anytime to bring it to the foreground."}}
8: [home, notification] Wait screen ready notification toggle: Adds an opt-in completion notification alert on the wait screen so users can safely switch windows during rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Generating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you when your pet is ready."}}
9: [finish, layout] Compact finish screen layout: Switches the home intro screen layout to compact mode with direct launch CTAs.
